summary: Biophytis SA filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026 disclosing an amendment to its straight bond financing agreement with Hexagon Capital Fund. The amendment converts the 2 million EUR facility into a revolving credit facility where each repaid bond renews draw capacity, up to 2,000 bonds outstanding at any time. The annual interest rate is reduced from 12% to 10%. This is a routine financing optimization, not a special situation event. No deal terms are stated as the filing concerns a credit facility amendment, not a merger, acquisition, or similar transaction.
